record.body:
## Evidence

The old area screen linked a moved idea to #/phase/<effort>/<phase>. The Started-as-efforts lines link to the effort only. R12 and R13 require only the effort link, and the user settled reference lines that link to the effort.

## Consequence

Phase merge is blocked until the finding is fixed or cleared.

## Follow-up

Human: confirm that dropping the phase link is intended.
